title: Direct Synthesis of Gold Nanoparticles on Cysteine-rich Tags in Mammalian Cells
protocol: Ultrasonic clean 3mmx0.16mm sapphire discs in 2mL microtubes containing 1 mL ethanol for 5 min.
Burn each sapphire disc in the flame of an alcohol lamp inside a laminar flow cabinet for 5 s.
Mark one side of each sapphire disc with a number using a solvent-resistant pen.
Place sapphire discs on the bottom of a 35mm culture dish or a well of 6-well cell culture plate (mark side down).
Sterilize the cell culture dish or plate containing sapphire discs under UV light for 30 min.
Aliquot cells into the cell culture dish or plate with sapphire discs.
Add proper amount of DMEM with 10% FBS and 200 mg/mL G418 or 50 mg/mL hygromycin B.
Place the cell culture dish or plate in a cell culture incubator for cell growth.
When the cell confluency reaches full confluence, prepare for further EM experiments.
Change the medium in the 35mm cell culture dish with 1 mL of 5 mM DTDPA in selected buffer (e.g., PBS, 0.2M HEPES, or DMEM with 10% FBS) for 30 min oxidization at 4°C.
Alternatively, change the medium with 1 mL of 25 mM MMTS in PBS for 5 min oxidizing at room temperature.
Add 4 µL of 25% GA to achieve a final concentration of 0.1%.
Fix cells in culture dish for 5-30 min at 4°C.
Change the solution in the culture dish with 1 mL of 50 mM glycine in PBS for neutralization at 4°C overnight.
Permeabilize with 1 mL of 0.1% triton X-100 in PBS in the culture dish at room temperature for 2 min.
Wash with 1 mL of PBS-A three times, each time for 5 minutes.
Fill the pre-cleaned 0.025 mm deep aluminum carrier with 2 μL of 1-hexadecene.
Pick a 3 mm x 0.16 mm sapphire disc and cap it onto the aluminum carrier with cells facing the cavity.
Load the capped carrier into the customized holder for high-pressure freezing.
Unload the carrier under liquid nitrogen in the foam cryobox and store in 2mL polypropylene microcentrifuge tubes in liquid nitrogen before use.
Load 1-4 specimens (attached on sapphire discs) into a 2mL polypropylene microtube with 1 mL of frozen freeze-substitution solvent under liquid nitrogen(LN₂).
Transfer the microtube to the pre-cooled to -90°C chamber of a Leica AFS2 freeze-substitution machine for FSF processing.
Keep the specimens in 1 mL of acetone containing 10 mM DTDPA + 5% ddH₂O + 1% methanol at -90°C for 12 hours.
Warm up gradually from -90°C to -20°C within 8 hours.
Stay at -20°C for 2 hours.
Cool back from -20°C to -30°C within 1 hour.
Add 10 μL of 10% GA (in acetone) to the microtube containing the DTDPA solution at -30°C for 5 hours fixation.
Change to pre-cooled -30 °C 30% ddH₂O in acetone, gradually warm up to -20 °C within 30 minutes.
Change to pre-cooled -20 °C 50% PBS in acetone, gradually warm up to 4 °C within 1 hour.
Change to pre-cooled 4 °C 70% PBS in acetone for 10 minutes.
Change to pre-cooled 4 °C PBS for 10 minutes.
Neutralize with 1 mL of 50 mM glycine in PBS at 4 °C overnight.
Wash with 1 mL PBS-A for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Keep the specimens in 1 mL of acetone at -90 °C for 3h.
Change to 1 mL of acetone containing 50 mM DTDPA + 0.02% TA + 5% ddH₂O at -90°C for 12h.
Warm up gradually from -90°C to -60°C within 5h.
Stay at -60°C for 10h.
Warm up gradually from -60°C to -35°C within 5h.
Change to 0.1% GA + 0.01% UA + 50 mM DTDPA+5% ddH₂O in acetone for 5h fixation at -35°C.
Change to 1 mL of acetone containing 30% 0.2M HEPES buffer for 30 min rehydration at -35°C.
Warm up from -35°C to 0°C within 10 min.
Replace with 1mL of RT 0.2M HEPES buffer containing 50 mM glycine at 0°C for 5 min.
Neutralize excess aldehyde with 1 mL of 50 mM glycine in PBS at 4 °C overnight.
Wash with 1 mL of PBS-A for 3 X 5 min.
Warm up gradually from -90°C to -60°C within 3 hours.
Wash with acetone for 3 times, each for 1 hour at -60°C.
Warm up gradually from -60°C to -30°C within 3 hours.
Add 2 µL of 10% UA in 1 mL of acetone for a final concentration of 0.01% UA and fix at -30°C for 3 hours.
Wash with acetone for 3 times, each for 30 minutes at -30°C.
Warm up gradually from -30°C to 4°C within 2 hours.

Transfer the sapphire disc (with cells attached) into a 35mm culture dish containing 1 mL of 0.2M HEPES with 1 mM CaCl₂ and 1 mM MgCl₂ (pH 7.4) for instant rehydration or drop into 70% acetone in 0.2 M HEPES with 1 mM CaCl₂ and 1 mM MgCl₂ (pH 7.4) for transitional rehydration.
Change to 0.2M HEPES with 1 mM CaCl₂ and 1 mM MgCl₂ (pH 7.4) at 4°C overnight.
Wash with PBS-A buffer for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Transfer 1-4 sapphire discs to a 35mm culture dish containing 1 mL of PBS-A buffer at room temperature.
Add 4.28 µL of 2-ME into the culture dish at room temperature.
Incubate for 1 hour.
Add 4.28 µL of 2-ME into a 2mL polypropylene microtube containing 1 mL of PBS-A buffer (pH 7.4).
Add 80 µL of 10 mM HAuCl₄, immediately vortex.
Add 80 µL of 500 mM D-P, vortex.
Change the solution in the culture dish with this mixture and incubate for 2 hours at 4 °C.
Add 20 µL of 100 mM NaBH₄ to the mixture, immediately shake to mix well.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Change the solution to 1 mL of PBS-A at 4 °C.
Disperse the cell pellet with 1 mL of room temperature PBS-A buffer in a 2mL polypropylene microtube.
Add 4.28 µL of 2-ME into the microtube at room temperature, and then incubate for 1 hour.
Add 80 µL of 10 mM HAuCl₄ to the microtube, immediately vortex.
Add 80 µL of 500 mM D-P, vortex.
Incubate for 2 hours at 4 °C.
Add 20 µL of 100 mM NaBH₄ to the mixture, immediately vortex to mix well.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 800 rpm for 2 minutes to obtain a cell pellet.
Change the solution to 1 mL of PBS-A at 4 °C.
Fill the pre-cleaned 0.025 mm deep aluminum carrier with 2 μL of 1-hexadecene.
Pick a 3 mm x 0.16 mm sapphire disc with forceps and quickly cap the disc onto a 0.025 mm deep aluminum carrier with the cells facing the cavity.
Load the capped carrier into the customized 3.05 x 0.66 mm HPF specimen holder for high pressure freezing.
Unload the carrier under liquid nitrogen in the foam cryobox and store in 2 mL polypropylene microcentrifuge tubes in liquid nitrogen before use.
Load specimens attached on sapphire discs into a 2 mL polypropylene microtube with 1 mL of frozen acetone containing 1% OsO₄ + 0.1% UA under LN₂.
Transfer the microtube to the pre-cooled to -90°C chamber and stay for 24 hours at -90 °C.
Warm up gradually from -90°C to -60°C within 5 hours.
Hold at -60°C for 6 hours.
Warm up gradually from -60°C to -20°C within 3 hours.
Hold at -20°C for 18 hours.
Warm up gradually from -20°C to 4°C within 2 hours.
Wash with acetone 3 times, each for 1 hour at 4 °C.
Warm up to room temperature for resin infiltration.
Immerse the sample in 5% GA under LN₂.
Transfer the microtube to the pre-cooled -90°C chamber of a Leica AFS2 freeze-substitution machine and incubate for 3 hours at -90°C.
Gradually warm up from -90°C to -60°C over 6 hours.
Wash with acetone three times, each for 1 hour at -60°C.
Add 10 μL of 1% HAuCl₄ in acetone to the microtube containing 1 mL of acetone and incubate for 8 hours at -60°C.
Add 10 µL of fresh 10 mM NaBH₄ to the solution and incubate for 20 hours at -60°C.
Wash with acetone three times, each for 1 hour at -60°C.
Change to 1 mL of 1% OsO₄ + 0.1% UA in acetone and fix for 5 hours at -60°C.
Gradually warm up from -60°C to -30°C over 5 hours.
Gradually warm up from -30°C to 4°C over 2 hours.
Wash with acetone three times, each for 1 hour at 4°C.
Warm up to room temperature for resin infiltration.
Infiltrate the sample with 1:1 SPI-Pon 812 resin:acetone for 1.5 hours on a rotator.
Infiltrate the sample with 3:1 SPI-Pon 812 resin:acetone for 6-12 hours on a rotator.
Infiltrate the sample with 100% SPI-Pon 812 resin for 1 hour on a rotator.
Infiltrate the sample with 100% SPI-Pon 812 resin for 3 hours on a rotator.
Infiltrate the sample with 100% SPI-Pon 812 resin for 1 hour on a rotator.
Transfer the resin-infiltrated sample attached on the sapphire disc to a flat-tip BEEM embedding capsule.
Incubate in fresh resin for 12 hours at 45°C followed by 24-48 hours at 60°C.
Trim the polymerized specimen carefully to expose the sapphire disc.
Dip into liquid nitrogen (LN₂) for 10 seconds to detach cells from the disc.
Separate the disc from the block using forceps.
Trim the block to a trapezoidal shape for thin sectioning at approximately 90 nm with a Lecia ultramicrotome.
Pick the sections on a 200-mesh hexagonal copper grid coated with or without formvar.
Thin sections (90 nm) on copper grids are stained with 2% uranyl acetate (UA) for 6 minutes or used unstained for EM imaging.
Directly use the thin sections for EM imaging on an FEI Spirit electron microscope operating at 120 kV.
Record images using a 4k x 4k 895 CCD camera under proper defocus values ranging from 11kX to 30kX.
